授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
授業テーマは、環境に関する必要最低限の基礎原理・知識を幅広く修得することである。
環境に対する関心は近年ますます拡がり、かつ、深まりつつあるが、当コースの学生にも幅広い環境に関する知識とその考え方を修得することが求められている。建設都市工学には、特に環境に配慮しなければならない領域として、技術者倫理と環境倫理分野、地球環境・地域環境・都市環境・環境システムなどの環境計画分野、水循環や水資源などの資源分野、上下水道・廃棄物処理のような都市施設分野、大気汚染・水質汚濁・土壌汚染・騒音防止のような環境保全分野など、多数ある。この講義では、これらいずれの分野の課題にも対応できるようにするための必要最低限の基礎原理・知識を幅広く修得し、現象の理解および環境問題の解決の上で必要となる基礎能力を身につける。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The concern about environment spreads increasingly and deeply in recent years, thus students of this department are also required to learn the broad knowledge and views about the environment. In the civil engineering, there are many areas in which we must consider the environment, such as fields of environment planning, resources, urban-facilities, environmental conservation, and so on. This course "Basics of Environmental Engineering" aims to learn minimum necessary basic principles and knowledge about environmental engineering broadly, for enabling to deal with any subject of these fields. In this lecture, the students, therefore, must acquire the basic abilities to understand the phenomenon and to provide satisfactory solutions to the environmental issues.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
A 知識・理解/ Knowledge and Understanding
To be able to:
- explain various chemical changes in environment,
- explain basic principles / theory about physical, chemical and biological water treatment processes,
- explain figures of the ecosystem and the flow of energy through the ecosystem, and microbial metabolisms and the metabolic model,
- explain the function of aquatic ecosystems
B 専門的技能/ Skills and other attributes
To be able to:
- perform calculation of free energy and chemical reaction rates,
- estimate chemical reactions concerning environmental pollution and water treatment processes
- propose the environmental conservation methods / techniques by applying the basic principles / theory about water treatment processes,
C汎用的技能/ Transferable Skills
To be able to:
- understand the points of issues, and explain the answers/countermeasures logically and briefly,
- calculate and derive the equations precisely and make figures/tables properly from the obtained equations and data, then explain the meanings clearly,
- use technical terms in the field of environmental engineering.
D態度・志向性/ Status and Value to Society
- Cultivation of engineering ethics and environmental ethics, and ability to explain the importance.
- Cultivation of ability to proceed things systematically and to take care of something by oneself.
- Cultivation of ability to study continuously.
